[LSIG.2.2.2] The runtime updates `SeriesBackendIntervalPulse`'s state
([LSIG.2.2.1]) on each transition assertion, at time $c$:

- on `true` (a rising edge): it sets $s_{\mathrm{open}} = c$, then evicts;
- on `false` (a falling edge) while $s_{\mathrm{open}}$ is present: it appends
  $(s_{\mathrm{open}}, c)$ to the intervals, adds $c - s_{\mathrm{open}}$ to $T$,
  clears $s_{\mathrm{open}}$, then evicts;
- on `false` while $s_{\mathrm{open}}$ is absent: nothing.

To evict is to remove every closed interval with $e_i \le c - W$, subtracting
its $e_i - s_i$ from $T$.
